pack_id: P5-NEW-PHYREXIA-HISTORY — Mirrodin corruption and early conquest

up_nph.title: New Phyrexia
up_nph.perspective: Wizards of the Coast (official Magic Story)

entities.name: Mortals brought to Mirrodin by Memnarch
Lifeforms transformed by oil beneath Mirrodin
Mirran survivors during New Phyrexia's conquest

claims.subject: memnarch
claims.source_excerpt: abducting mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane
claims.summary: Memnarch brought abducted mortals to the metal plane Mirrodin.
claims.limitation: The overview does not list every origin plane or person.

claims.subject: karn
claims.source_excerpt: Karn was the bringer of the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin
claims.summary: Karn unintentionally introduced the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin.
claims.limitation: The official overview identifies the vector but does not establish Karn's intent or exact transmission method.

claims.subject: glistening_oil
claims.source_excerpt: began the slow process of transforming the creatures it touched deep beneath the world's surface
claims.summary: Phyrexian oil gradually transformed affected beings underground on Mirrodin.
claims.limitation: A general origin mechanism, not evidence that every Mirran was compleated.

claims.subject: new_phyrexia
claims.source_excerpt: an active campaign to alter, or compleat, the world of Mirrodin
claims.summary: The oil's spread escalated into the Phyrexian campaign to compleat Mirrodin, producing New Phyrexia.
claims.limitation: This is an early historical trajectory; later events in March of the Machine must be tracked separately.

claims.subject: mirran_resistance
claims.source_excerpt: The Mirrans fought many battles, but they soon were overwhelmed
claims.summary: Mirran forces resisted the early Phyrexian conquest but were overwhelmed.
claims.limitation: No claim that every Mirran died or that every resistance effort failed forever.

claims.subject: new_phyrexia
claims.source_excerpt: Even the Planeswalkers Koth, Elspeth, and Venser could not turn the tide
claims.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser were among planeswalkers unable to reverse the early Phyrexian conquest.
claims.limitation: This evaluates the early campaign; it does not negate their actions in later stories.

claims.subject: new_phyrexia
claims.source_excerpt: their factions fight for power amongst themselves
claims.summary: The official early New Phyrexia overview describes rival praetor factions struggling for power.
claims.limitation: The page's historical present cannot be taken as the current political state after March of the Machine.

claims.subject: mirran_survivors_early_nph
claims.source_excerpt: the natives struggle daily to survive
claims.summary: Mirran survivors faced daily threats under early New Phyrexian domination.
claims.limitation: This does not identify present-day survivors or establish New Phyrexia's current accessibility.

remaining: Trace later praetor and Mirran arcs through official stories; do not apply early-profile present tense to the aftermath of March of the Machine.
No inferred current ruler, AR year, total-war chronology or approval is established.
No deckbuilding while the foundation-first hold is active.
